caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object that appears to be a three-legged structure. It is rendered in grayscale with shades of black and gray. The object consists of three main parts: two curved legs that are set on the left and lower side, and a third, straight horizontal bar extending to the right, ending with a downward bend at a right angle. There is a vertical post rising from where the legs meet, with the top of the post curving outward and terminating in a faceted, knob-like shape. The entire object has a textured appearance suggestive of a wrought or cast material. The composition centers the object against a plain background, with no other elements visible.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
